Slim electronic kitchen scale

Category Tableware
Brand Guzzini
Collection Guzzini
Year 2013

The Slim electronic kitchen scale looks like the latest tablets: sober, clean, smooth on the surface, it invites tactile touch, is available in different colors.

Its maximum capacity is 5 kg and has a double g/oz measurement, tare function, auto-shutoff and four anti-slip feet which guarantee its stability.

The electronic kitchen scale from Ora-Ito for Guzzini offers a large and practical white LED display that makes reading easy.
